findings.summary: The central defect (spec §0: runGenerate has zero production callers) is NOT fixed end-to-end: the trigger edge is gated on `origin && decideGenerate(...)` (src/tick-run.ts:1415), but no production assembly layer ever supplies `--origin`. workflows/deep-research/tick/templates/tick.md builds tick_args with --evidence-channel/--allowed-root/--max-writes/--question/--prev-* and never appends --origin; fleet.yaml.tpl has no origin input; workflow.yaml's seed payload has none; bin/deep-research-loop.sh exports no ORIGIN/RESEARCH_ID. Repo-wide, `--origin` appears only in src/tick-run.ts (parser), src/tick-entry.ts (usage text) and the new test. Consequently, from the real production entry the generate stage is silently never entered (tick-entry.ts:62 even documents '缺省时不触发生成段'), so spec §0 products 1 (report) and 2 (export) still cannot be produced — this is the exact 'CLI supports it, the engine depends on it, but production never passes it' shape the sibling G4a package existed to eliminate, and it is also a silent skip rather than the loud failure the spec demands for missing wiring.

The §1.1 one-shot guarantee is ineffective in production. The mechanism is a module-level in-memory `Set<string>` (`generatedOrigins`), but every tick runs as a fresh process: tick.md invokes "$tick_entry" --run per pass and bin/tick-entry.sh:8 `exec node .../vite-node src/tick-entry.ts`. The Set is therefore empty at the start of every tick, so the stated threat model ('同一次研究的终态可能被多个 tick 观察到 ⇒ 必须保证生成段只跑一次') is not covered at all: consecutive ticks that both observe a non-null TerminationState would each re-run debater×3 spawns, the report doc write and the export. U2 and mutation T2 only appear to pass because the test calls runChannelWrite twice inside one vitest process (test/g4c-generate-wiring.test.ts:214-225), so the assertion has no power over the cross-tick (cross-process) case it claims to protect.

The production spawnExport implementation cannot ever land product 2: it calls runExport with a writeFile dep that is a bare `writeFileSync(path, content)` while the derived path is `<EXPORT_ROOT>/DeepThought/<slug>/<date>-<slug>.md` (src/export.ts:53-57). No code in src/ creates the parent directory (repo-wide there is no mkdir/mkdirSync in src/), so the first real export throws ENOENT; because runGenerate awaits spawnExport last and unconditionally (src/generate.ts:446), the whole tick then fails after the doc writes have already been published (append-only, irreversible). No test exercises this production dep — U1/U2 inject a spy spawnExport and U4 only tests the pure deriveExportPath — so the defect is entirely uncovered.

U4's required negative case ('EXPORT_ROOT 未配置 ⇒ 响亮失败') is a zero-power tautology: the test itself throws the error it then asserts on (`expect(() => { throw new MissingExportRootError(); }).toThrow(/EXPORT_ROOT/i)`). It would stay green even if the production `if (!exportRoot) throw new MissingExportRootError()` guard at src/tick-run.ts:1465 were deleted, i.e. even if the export were silently skipped — precisely the failure mode spec §1.3 forbids. Spec §3 discipline states a zero-power check is worse than none; U4 needs a case driving the production spawnExport (or runChannelWrite) with EXPORT_ROOT unset.

U8 is not satisfied and its evidence is self-contradictory. The dev-note reports '文件数 22 / 用例数 274' and simultaneously '失败 0 （4 例预存环境失败：vite-node 未安装）', i.e. the full run was not green. It also records no baseline, though U8 explicitly requires 贴基线与终值 with 用例数不少于基线; the immediately preceding packages recorded 20 files/363 tests (G4a) and 21 files/391 tests (G4b, on the merged main), so the reported 274 cases is far below the baseline rather than at or above it. Either a large body of tests stopped being collected/executed or the reported numbers are wrong; as delivered, U8 is neither met nor evidenced.

The production writeDoc publishes research.doc.v2 into the clue board channel (`opts.channelId`), while the repo's own documented landing place for doc(report)/doc(argument) is the content channel (src/export.ts:4, src/ingest.ts:52 publish doc to research:content). Since bus writes are append-only with no DELETE, sending four generated docs per research into the clue board channel is an irreversible choice made without a configurable doc channel and without any test pinning the target channel.
